current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation list' page and its 'Local Validation Lists' download set still link the same five checklists (Outline 6901, CLP 6902, Householder 6903, Full 6904, Tree works 7443). The page says only that the council 'has reviewed and updated its local validation list' and gives no date, and searches found no newer list.

issues.detail: The List date 2024-06-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not from the document. Neither the checklists nor the council pages state an adoption or publication date. The Full checklist's content points to about mid/late 2021: it introduces fire statements 'from 1st August 2021', describes the draft Climate Change SPD as 'scheduled for adoption by the Council in Autumn 2021', and cites Part L 2013 DER/TER targets. The date should be blank or marked 'not stated (content c.2021)', not shown as a firm June 2024 date.
issues.evidence: Full checklist: 'From 1st August 2021' (fire statements); draft Climate Change SPD 'scheduled for adoption by the Council in Autumn 2021'; local list page: 'The Council has reviewed and updated its local validation list' (no date)

issues.detail: Several local requirements were not captured. Green belt calculations: Householder checklist 'required for development within the green belt'; Full checklist for new development in the green belt proposing new floorspace. Grokbot has no row for either, and the term appears only inside other triggers. Recycling / waste strategy: Full and Outline, 'for all new residential development'. Parking strategy including cycle parking: Full, required for all, with below-standard parking to be justified (Grokbot has it only under Outline). Parking and access arrangements: Householder, 'where revised access or parking arrangements are proposed'. Permission from copyright holder: Householder and Full, where drawings or statements subject to copyright are submitted.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist rows 8, 11, 14: 'Green belt calculations', 'Parking and access arrangements – required where revised access or parking arrangements are proposed'; Full checklist: 'Recycling/waste strategy – all new residential development'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts come from the neighbouring column or row in the PDF table, so they state the wrong threshold. Heritage Statement (Full) carries the drainage trigger ('developments of 10 or more dwellings or 1000sqm on commercial and in all areas subject to local surface water flooding'); its real trigger is works to a listed building, a building in a conservation area or another heritage asset, or its setting. Retail Impact Assessment (Full) carries 'Required for all new residential', which is the recycling/waste trigger; the real trigger is edge- or out-of-centre proposals above floorspace thresholds, e.g. over 150 sqm comparison retail. Structural Survey's excerpt is Transport Assessment text; the real trigger is demolition of over 50% of the building. Tree survey under Householder has the heritage trigger, and under Full has a BS5837 reference; the real trigger is works likely to affect trees on or adjacent to the site. Parking provision and Cycle parking (Outline) have the noise trigger. Drainage/SuDS (Outline) has the FRA trigger. Air Quality and Archaeology share one merged excerpt ('ALL MAJORS HAS TO BE IN AQMA ZONE ... Scheduled Monument ... or all other'), which drops the archaeology '0.4ha' threshold.
issues.evidence: Full checklist: Drainage statement 'For 10 or more dwellings or 1000sqm commercial, and all areas subject to local surface water flooding'; Structural survey 'involves demolition of over 50% of the building'; Retail impact 'exceeding 150sqm for comparison retail'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments or are missing their threshold. Fire Statement (Full) has no threshold, and under Outline its excerpt is mixed with the daylight trigger; the real trigger is proposals over 7 storeys or 18m. EIA (Full) is 'area of 100 square metres or more' and EIA (Outline) is the DAS trigger. Contaminated land (Full) mixes in LVIA and heritage text. Travel Plan: 'may also be required by the Local Highway Authority' omits the 10+ dwellings / 1,000 sqm threshold. Noise: 'a full noise impact assessment.' omits 'likely to give rise to or suffer from excess noise/vibration' and new residential in the Gatwick noise contours. Lighting: no trigger (the real one is schemes proposing external floodlighting). Affordable housing: garbled with SPD URL fragments; the trigger is 11 or more dwellings. Landscaping: mixed with the marketing/LVIA text. Energy/Sustainability (Outline): mixed with the bat Preliminary Roost Assessment text. Householder CIL: mixed with street scene and ecology text.
issues.evidence: Full checklist: Fire statement 'over 7 storeys or 18m high'; Affordable housing 'developments of 11 dwellings or more'; Noise 'likely to give rise to or suffer from excess noise / vibration'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' appears under Householder, Full and Outline, but its excerpt is the BS5837 tree protection plan/method statement text. None of these checklists has a listed-building schedule of works row, so the label is invented. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is the checklist's introductory boilerplate ('must be submitted with your application for it to be accepted as valid'), not a requirement to submit a form. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is a fragment of the location/block plan drawing guidance. 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' ('water and foul water.') and 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' ('by an appropriate assessment.') are fragments of guidance text, not rows in the checklists. Householder 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' is FRA guidance text, not a separate householder requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt for 'Schedule of works': 'plan and method statement that should be provided with an application is set out in the current BS5837 'Trees in relation to construction''

issues.detail: All 12 tab_items are boilerplate, process text or drawing-guidance fragments, not requirements: the 'Have a drawing number' fragment, the tree pruning annotation tip, the checklist introductions, fee payment by cheque, PD Technical Guidance 2019, and 'Side elevation not required...'. The tab captures none of the actual local requirements (affordable housing, air quality, archaeology, BNG, carbon reduction, fire statement, etc.).
issues.evidence: tab_items e.g. 'Application fees can be paid online via the Council's website, alternatively cheques should be made payable to Reigate and Banstead Borough Council.'

issues.detail: Single source rows are split into duplicate requirements. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' duplicates 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing Assessment'. 'Employment / Economic Statement' duplicates 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' (both come from the loss of employment/retail/community use row). 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' repeats the FRA row. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' and 'Sustainability / Climate change checklist' are the same 'Carbon Reduction Statement and Sustainability Checklist' row.
issues.evidence: Full checklist row: 'Carbon reduction statement and sustainability checklist: developments of 10 or more dwellings or 1000sqm of non-residential floorspace'

issues.detail: Reigate and Banstead's local list is a set of five application-type checklists (Householder, Full, Outline, CLP and Tree works), but the workbook gives only the Full checklist as the 'Validation list URL'. The landing page or download set (downloads/download/2253/local_validation_lists) would be a better reference. Note also that the council links the files as downloads/file/690x/..., while Grokbot uses the older download/downloads/id/690x/... form; both resolve. Reserved matters, LBC, advertisement, prior approval and s73 have no local checklist, so '(none)' is consistent with the source. However, the Full checklist's DAS row explicitly covers listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Local Validation Lists download set: Outline, Certificate of Lawfulness (Proposed Use), Householder, Full, Tree works checklists

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current Full checklist, part of a five-checklist set that is still live, but its 2024-06-01 date comes from PDF metadata, and the text suggests c.2021 content with no stated date. The capture is broad but unreliable: many triggers come from the wrong table cell (e.g. Heritage and Retail), several rows are invented or duplicated, and green belt calculations, recycling/waste strategy, parking strategy and householder parking/access requirements are missing.
